title: Over 65 | Temple ISD Election 2026
description:
There will not be an increase in taxes for senior citizens or disabled persons as a result of these propositions. School property taxes for senior citizens and disabled persons are frozen and would not be affected by passage of Prop A and Prop B as long as the homeowner has applied for and received the Over 65 Homestead Exemption with the Bell County Appraisal District. Your ISD taxes will not exceed the frozen dollar amount.
 
There will also be a Proposition on the November ballot to increase the homestead exemption to two hundred thousand dollars for homeowners 65 and over.

The ballot language can be confusing. Since 2019, state law has required school districts to have the phrase” THIS IS A PROPERTY TAX INCREASE” in the ballot language for all bond propositions. However, homeowners aged 65 and older or disabled persons who have applied for and received the Over 65 Exemption will not see an increase over their frozen dollar amount if there have been no major improvements or additions to their home. Check your most recent Notice of Assessed Value Change to see if you will be impacted.

More information on Prop A and Prop B is available on the district’s website at T-I-S-D dot org slash Election 2025.

Early voting runs October 20th through October 31st and Election Day is November 4th. Please exercise your right to vote and make your voice heard in this election.

www.tisd.org/Election2025
